cmd: tc filter add dev v0p1 parent ffff: handle 1 protocol ip prio 1 basic match 'canid(eff 1 eff 2 eff 3)' classid 1:1

match.pattern: (?sm)^filter parent ffff: protocol ip pref 1 basic.*handle 0x1 flowid 1:1.*canid\(eff 0x1 eff 0x2 eff 0x3\)
